ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a full larder
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Stock thirty days of food for the colony, enough to get through a failed harvest or a long winter.

plain.li: We're eating what we harvest about as fast as we bring it in. Let's put a month of food by before the lean months.
An extra field this season, and a hunt whenever the herds come through. It all goes on the shelves until they're full.

warm.li: Whatever happens this year, I don't want anyone here going to bed hungry. Help me fill the storeroom.

blunt.li: One bad harvest and we're eating bark. Fill the larder.

cheerful.li: Jars up to the rafters and a ham on every hook. That's the storeroom I want!

gloomy.li: The lean months always last longer than the food does. We should start putting it away now.

cold.li: A bad raid might cost us two people. An empty storeroom would cost us all of them.

plain.li: The shelves are full. Whatever this winter brings, we'll eat.

cheerful.li: I had to climb over a sack of potatoes to reach the back shelf!

cold.li: Thirty days of food in store. I'll recount it at midwinter.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a cold store
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a freezer and keep thirty meals in it, so food stops spoiling and there's always something ready to eat.

plain.li: Raw meat lasts a few days on an open shelf. Give me a freezer and I'll keep thirty meals ready instead of racing the rot.

warm.li: A cold room full of ready meals would mean the night shift eats when they come in, instead of waiting on me.

blunt.li: I'm sick of cooking food just to scrape it into the midden.

cheerful.li: A freezer full of meals, and I'll label every shelf!

gloomy.li: Everything rots here if you leave it long enough. We could at least save the food.

cold.li: We lose more food to rot than to raiders. That's the easier loss to stop.

plain.li: The shelves are full, the air's cold and nothing in there is rotting.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a real hospital
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a hospital with three beds and keep fifteen medicine in stock, so the wounded have somewhere clean to recover.

plain.li: Our wounded lie wherever there's an empty bed. They need one clean room, with three beds and the medicine close by.
Three clean beds and a cabinet of medicine would save a life the next time a raid goes badly.

warm.li: I don't want to lose anyone just because we weren't ready for them. A hospital, please.

blunt.li: You people keep getting shot. Build me a hospital so I can keep you alive.

cheerful.li: I'd love to run a real hospital. I've already worked out which shelf the bandages go on.

gloomy.li: Someone will get badly hurt again; it's only a question of when. We should have beds ready.

cold.li: The wounded recover faster and die less often in a real hospital. I consider it necessary.

plain.li: Three beds made up and the medicine shelved. I hope they stay empty.

blunt.li: Good. Now stop getting shot.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: rooms of our own
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Give every colonist a bedroom of their own instead of a bed in the barracks.

plain.li: A private room for each of us, with a door that closes. That's my proposal.
People sleep badly in the barracks, and it shows in their work. I want private rooms.

warm.li: I'd like each of us to have a room to keep our own things in. It would feel more like home.

blunt.li: I'm done sleeping with someone's feet by my head.

cheerful.li: A room for each of us, with a name sign on every door!

gloomy.li: We can't get a night's peace from each other in there. Sooner or later someone will snap.

cold.li: I've listened at the barracks door at night. People in there wake every hour.

plain.li: A room for everyone. This feels like a real settlement now.

cheerful.li: I painted a name sign for every door!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a great hall
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Turn the dining room into a hall worth gathering in, furnished and decorated until its impressiveness reaches 65.

plain.li: I'd like the dining room to be somewhere grand, with a good floor and some art on the walls.

warm.li: It's the one room where we're all together at once. It deserves better than a dirt floor and a wobbly table.

blunt.li: Our dining room looks like a pirate's latrine. Build a proper hall.

cheerful.li: Banners on the walls, and a seat at the head of the table for whoever cooked!

gloomy.li: We'll eat thousands of meals in that room before we're done.

cold.li: Every one of us sits in that room at least once a day. No other room we could improve reaches as many people.

plain.li: The next caravan through will be talking about this hall for weeks.

cheerful.li: I'm making the first toast in here, and it's going to be a long one!

li.label: the first feast in the great hall

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: fun and games
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a recreation room with at least five different kinds of recreation in the colony.

plain.li: We work all day, and in the evenings the only entertainment is the cook's singing. I propose a rec room.

warm.li: After a hard day I'd like somewhere to sit with all of you that isn't the dining table.

blunt.li: If I have to watch one more cloud, I'm going to set fire to the woodpile. Rec room.

cheerful.li: A whole room just for games! Who's with me?

gloomy.li: There's nothing to do here after dark but sit and think. That isn't good for any of us.

cold.li: People with nothing to do in the evening find something to do. I'd rather choose what it is.

plain.li: Game night is officially a colony tradition.

blunt.li: The rules are on the wall. Anyone caught cheating sweeps the room.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: hold the line
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build up the colony's defenses until they match the raids your wealth attracts, and put up eight new pieces of cover where the fighting happens.

plain.li: The raids are getting bigger and our defenses aren't. We need to catch up before the next one.
I propose we spend the next few weeks on cover and weapons, and pick a place to make our stand.

warm.li: None of us has slept a whole night since the last raid. Let's make the defenses solid enough that we can.

blunt.li: Every raid I end up crouched behind a sack of rice. Build me a real wall to crouch behind.

cheerful.li: Let's make our home the last place any raider wants to visit!

gloomy.li: They'll come again, with more people next time. Let's make it cost them.

cold.li: We've grown rich faster than we've grown dangerous. Raiders notice that before we do.

plain.li: The barricades are up and we all know where to stand when the alarm goes.

blunt.li: Now I almost want them to try something.

gloomy.li: We're safer than we were. I'll still sleep in my boots.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a ring of iron
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build three turrets to cover the colony's approaches.

plain.li: Turrets don't sleep, don't eat and don't panic. Let's put three on the main approaches.

blunt.li: I want guns that keep firing while we're asleep.

cheerful.li: Three little guards that never sleep! I'm giving them names.

gloomy.li: There are too few of us to watch every approach, and whoever's on watch dozes off eventually.

cold.li: Every shot a turret fires is one none of us has to stand up to fire.

plain.li: The guns are up. The approaches are covered.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: teeth in the mud
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build six traps along the approaches, so attackers are hurt before they reach your walls.

plain.li: The raiders always come in by the same few paths. That's where the traps should go.

warm.li: I'd rather they get hurt out there than we get hurt in here. Let's set some traps.

blunt.li: Spikes in the ground along the path they always take. I'll dig the holes myself.

cheerful.li: I've drawn a map of where every trap should go, with little stars on it!

gloomy.li: It's ugly work, setting traps for people. Burying our own is worse.

cold.li: A trap costs a few logs and needs no one standing behind it. I find that efficient.

plain.li: Mind where you step past the fields now.

cold.li: The approaches are now hostile. Good.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: keep the lights on
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build two batteries and store 1500 Wd of power, so the lights and heaters stay on through nights, still days and eclipses.

plain.li: Every time the sun sets, the lights flicker. Let's build batteries and stop holding our breath at dusk.

blunt.li: The power keeps cutting out at the worst moments. I'm always the one sent out to check the wires.

cheerful.li: Let's store up enough power to keep every lamp lit all night!

gloomy.li: One eclipse and the freezer thaws, and then we're eating spoiled meat. I'd like batteries.

cold.li: Every night this colony runs on luck until sunrise. I'd rather it ran on stored power.

plain.li: The lights stayed on all night, and the freezer never warmed up.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the workshop
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a proper workshop with at least two crafting stations.

plain.li: Everything we wear gets made in a corner of the storeroom, between the potato sacks.

warm.li: I'd keep all of you in decent boots and coats if I had a real workshop to work in.

blunt.li: You want gear? Then give me a workshop, not a bench in the rain.

cheerful.li: A workshop that smells of sawdust and glue! I can't wait.

gloomy.li: Everything we own is falling apart, and there's nowhere decent to make new things.

cold.li: Every order I take waits days for a free bench. Those are days of work we never get back.

plain.li: Benches are in and the tools are hung. Bring me your torn boots.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a gallery of our own
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Place three works of art in the dining room or rec room.

plain.li: Three sculptures in the dining room, where we'll see them every day. I've already picked the spots.

warm.li: It's been a hard year, and all I've made in it are walls and coffins. Let me make art for once.

blunt.li: The dining room is depressing. Let me put some art in it.

cheerful.li: A gallery. I've got sketches for twenty pieces and room for three, so I'll have to choose.

gloomy.li: Most days here are gray and the same. Some art on the walls would help.

cold.li: Art raises what the colony is worth and how people feel in it, and it doesn't eat.

plain.li: Three pieces of art in the common rooms, and people actually stop to look at them.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the menagerie
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Tame three new animals and give them a barn to sleep in.

plain.li: Some of the animals out there could haul for us, and some would give milk. Let's tame three and build them a barn.

warm.li: I miss hearing animals in the morning. A few around the place would make it feel alive.

blunt.li: Free labor is walking around out there on four legs. Tame it.

cheerful.li: A barn full of animals! I want one of everything.

gloomy.li: Animals don't argue and they don't lie. I could use their company.

cold.li: A tamed animal will carry, guard and breed, and it asks for nothing but hay.

plain.li: Listen to them. That's the sound of a real homestead.

cheerful.li: I've named every one of them, and two already come when I call!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the pursuit of knowledge
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Set up a proper laboratory and complete three research projects.

plain.li: Give me a quiet room with a research bench and I'll finish three projects for us.

warm.li: I'd like to find easier ways to do the work that's wearing all of you down.

blunt.li: We're stumbling around in the dark. Let me do some actual research.

cheerful.li: New discoveries, and probably a small explosion or two!

gloomy.li: We won't survive on what we know now. We have to learn more.

cold.li: Every project we finish opens the way to two more. The sooner we start, the further it goes.

plain.li: Three projects finished. I've already started on the fourth.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a greenhouse
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Grow food indoors, under a sun lamp or in hydroponics, so the seasons stop deciding the harvest, and keep twenty days of food in store.

plain.li: Under lamps, indoors, we could bring in a harvest in the middle of winter.

warm.li: Fresh greens on the table in the middle of winter. I'd love to see that.

blunt.li: Crops under a roof don't freeze.

cheerful.li: A whole room of growing things that smells like spring all year!

gloomy.li: We're one bad season away from eating the seed grain. Growing indoors is the only way around it I can see.

cold.li: The fields feed us half the year. A greenhouse would feed us the other half.

plain.li: Green and growing, whatever the weather.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a warm winter
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put a heat source in every bedroom before the cold sets in.

plain.li: Winter's on its way. I want a heat source in every bedroom before it gets here.

warm.li: I don't want anyone shivering themselves to sleep this winter.

blunt.li: My room was so cold last winter the water froze in the cup. Heat in every bedroom.

cheerful.li: Cozy rooms for all of us, and winter can knock all it likes!

gloomy.li: The cold doesn't kill you all at once. It wears you down over a season.

cold.li: The cold kills slowly and predictably. That makes it the easiest thing here to stop.

plain.li: Every bedroom has its own heat now. Let it snow.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: new blood
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Welcome at least one new colonist: recruit a prisoner, take in a refugee, or answer a call for help.

plain.li: Whoever cooks also hauls, and whoever hauls also stands the night watch. We need one more of us.

warm.li: There are people out there with nowhere to go. Let's give one of them a home.

blunt.li: We need more people, and I'm not fussy about where they come from.

cheerful.li: A new friend. I'll even give them my second-best spoon.

gloomy.li: There aren't enough of us to survive what's coming.

cold.li: We have more work than workers, and the work isn't getting smaller.

plain.li: Welcome. Pick yourself a bed, and supper's at dusk.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: good times
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Raise the colony's average mood to 65%: deal with complaints, feed people well and give them time to rest.

plain.li: People are tense. Let's spend a while making this place better to live in, not just bigger.

warm.li: I've seen how tired you all are. For a while, I'd like the work to come second.

blunt.li: Everyone's miserable and it's making me miserable. Let's fix it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to get a smile out of every one of you at least once a day!

gloomy.li: Someone's going to snap soon. I've seen how people look at each other over supper.

cold.li: When people are this unhappy, one breakdown sets off the next. I'd rather not find out how many.

plain.li: Listen to that. People are laughing again.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a full treasury
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Save up 2000 silver for trade, ransoms and emergencies.

plain.li: When the next trader comes, I want to buy what we need, not beg. Let's save up silver.

warm.li: Silver put aside could buy medicine the week someone's sick and the shelf is empty.

blunt.li: Traders laugh at what we have to offer. Save some silver.

cheerful.li: Let's get so rich the traders bow when they see us coming!

gloomy.li: Someday we'll need to buy our way out of trouble. Better have the silver.

cold.li: Silver doesn't rot and doesn't need feeding. More of what we own should be silver.

plain.li: The treasury's full. I counted it twice.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: fine dining
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Give the cooks a real kitchen and stock twenty fine meals.

plain.li: Give me a real kitchen and good ingredients and I'll give you meals worth fighting for.

warm.li: I'd love to cook for all of you the way my mother cooked for us, with herbs and a slow fire.

blunt.li: I'm cooking on a stove wedged into a corridor. Give me a kitchen.

cheerful.li: Fine dining out here on the Rim, garnish and all!

gloomy.li: We eat the same mush day after day, and I've started to taste the despair in it.

cold.li: A fine meal costs a cook an hour and buys a day of good temper from whoever eats it.

plain.li: Dinner is served. There's a sauce, and it has herbs in it.
